theorems.name: Submission.dgcr_stc_exists_normalized_mollifier
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (r : ℝ), 0 < r → ∃ ρ : Euclid n → ℝ, ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ρ ∧ HasCompactSupport ρ ∧ (∀ x, 0 ≤ ρ x) ∧ ∫ x, ρ x = 1 ∧ support ρ ⊆ ball (0 : Euclid n) r
